description: Real AES-256-GCM envelope-encryption sample (WO-015 acceptance criteria: 'sample keys, ciphertext blobs... for CI/CD use'). Generated once with the same primitives InMemoryKmsService uses — not a fabricated shape. Illustrative only: the tenant master key that wrapped encryptedDataKey is intentionally NOT included, so this blob cannot be decrypted standalone. That's the entire point of envelope encryption / BYOK — ciphertext is meaningless without the customer's key, which this repository never holds. Structural fixtures for actual round-trip tests are generated live against InMemoryKmsService in backend/test/encryption/kms-envelope.test.ts, since a real KMS's master key material can't be a static, checked-in fixture.

invalid.reason: GCM auth tag must reject any single-byte modification to ciphertext

invalid.case: wrong tenant's master key used to unwrap encryptedDataKey
invalid.reason: unwrap must fail — this is what test_rls-style cross-tenant isolation looks like for encryption instead of row visibility

invalid.case: keyVersion referencing a version the tenant never had
invalid.reason: decrypt must reject rather than silently using the current version's key
